item.title: Albania formalises corruption charges against ex-deputy PM Balluku
item.description: Prosecutors in Albania have formalised corruption charges against former deputy prime minister Belinda Balluku, whose original indictment a year ago triggered rioting in Tirana.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Prosecutors in Albania have formalised corruption charges against former deputy prime minister Belinda Balluku, whose original indictment a year ago triggered rioting in Tirana. Balluku, who served as deputy to Prime Minister Edi Rama and also as an infrastructure minister, was charged [USN:L6N3WW0RW TEXT:"late last year"] with interfering in the award of two construction contracts in 2021 worth more than €200 million ($225 million). Corruption in public institutions has been one of the drivers this month of new, student-led protests and rioting in the capital Tirana calling for Rama to step down. On Tuesday, protesters gathered outside an education ministry building shouting "Balluku to jail!", and were pushed back by police using water cannon and tear gas. Balluku, 53, has made no public comment since denying wrongdoing in response to the original charges. Rama dismissed her in February but an attempt to strip her of her parliamentary immunity, which prevents her being arrested, failed. She did not respond to a request for comment on Tuesday. In an emailed statement to media, the Special Prosecution Office, which handles high-level corruption, said the final charges against Balluku included violation of the equality of participants in public tenders or auctions, and passive corruption of persons including high-ranking state officials. She was also charged with laundering the proceeds of criminal activity. "The Special Prosecution Office is continuing to take concrete procedural steps to formally communicate the charges to the other individuals involved in the same criminal case," it said. Rama, who has refused to step down, has condemned the violence. He said that the government would consider lowering the age for criminal liability and imposing a social media ban for those under 16 years old to counter the protests. ($1 = 0.8888 euros)

item.title: Russia hits cargo vessels, logistics hubs in Ukraine, Russian defence ministry says
item.description: The Russian military struck three cargo vessels in Ukraine's port of Reni and two other cargo vessels en route to Odesa, Russia's defence ministry said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Russian military struck three cargo vessels in Ukraine's port of Reni and two other cargo vessels en route to Odesa, Russia's defence ministry said on Tuesday. item.title: US senior housing operator Discovery Senior Living explores sale, sources say
item.description: The owners of Discovery Senior Living are exploring a sale of one of the largest senior housing operators in the US that could value it at more than $1 billion, according to two people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Abigail Summerville
item.content:encoded: The owners of Discovery Senior Living are exploring a sale of one of the largest senior housing operators in the US that could value it at more than $1 billion, according to two people familiar with the matter. The company, which operates and manages around 450 senior living and retirement communities in 40 states, is working with investment bank William Blair on the process, the people said, speaking on the condition of anonymity because the matter is private. Private equity firms Lee Equity Partners and Coastwood Senior Housing Partners invested in Discovery in 2022. The company generates around $65 million of annual earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, the people said. Discovery, William Blair, and Lee Equity did not respond to requests for comment. Coastwood could not be reached for comment. Investors have been drawn to the residential property management sector for its recurring fees and exposure to housing demand without having to own the underlying real estate. For example, New Mountain Capital agreed to buy Asset Living, which provides services to multifamily, student, and affordable housing communities, for over $2 billion, Reuters [USN:L6N42616X TEXT:"reported "]in June. The senior housing sector, in particular, is drawing investor interest as baby boomers reach retirement age. On its website, Discovery describes senior housing as a "ground-floor opportunity to capitalize on a once-in-a-generation megatrend for investors and our society." Discovery uses a regional management model in which it partners with real estate investment trusts and other investors who own the underlying real estate. The Bonita Springs, Florida-based company agreed to buy Oregon-based Sunshine Retirement Living earlier this month, expanding in the Pacific Northwest. The underlying Sunshine communities will remain under existing ownership, including Sabra Healthcare REIT and Investcorp, the deal announcement said. Discovery, founded in the 1990s, operates communities including Discovery Village and Aston Gardens in Florida, Conservatory in Texas, and Rittenhouse Village in Pennsylvania and other states.

item.title: Kenya confirms new Ebola case, total at nine, health ministry says
item.description: Kenya has confirmed a new Ebola case, bringing the total number of infections to nine, the health ministry said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya has confirmed a new Ebola case, bringing the total number of infections to nine, the health ministry said on Tuesday. The ministry said the latest case was a close family member of the first patient and had already been placed in quarantine. "All nine cases belong to one cluster, and as of today there is no evidence of transmission outside this group," Director-General for Health Patrick Amoth said in a statement. Kenya has been on high alert as a major Ebola outbreak centred in Democratic Republic of Congo has spread across borders in the region. Kenya's first Ebola case was identified earlier this month in a man who travelled from DRC to Nairobi and died at a Nairobi hospital on October 5. Late on Monday, the US State Department [USN:L1N466022 TEXT:"advised"] Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel advisory level for the country because of health risks. Amoth said 134 of 135 contacts had been traced and placed in quarantine as of Tuesday.

item.title: Missouri tells court China missed chance to challenge $24 billion COVID ruling
item.description: Missouri has urged a judge to reject arguments by three Chinese government-linked entities trying to escape a $24.5 billion judgment tied to the COVID-19 pandemic, arguing they waited more than a year after the ruling to appear in US court and challenge it.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: Missouri has urged a judge to reject arguments by three Chinese government-linked entities trying to escape a $24.5 billion judgment tied to the COVID-19 pandemic, arguing they waited more than a year after the ruling to appear in US court and challenge it. China's Hubei province, the epicenter of the 2019 coronavirus outbreak, and two other defendants chose not to participate in earlier proceedings in the lawsuit, the US state said in a filing in Missouri federal court on Monday. Missouri said the Chinese defendants, sued by the US state in 2020, “are about six years too late. Seeking a do-over, China tries to contest facts that Missouri established to this Court’s satisfaction.” The Chinese embassy in the US and lawyers for Hubei province at law firm White & Case did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Missouri’s attorney general's office also did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Missouri in April 2020 [USN:KCN2232UR TEXT:"filed the first-of-its-kind lawsuit"] against Hubei and other Chinese defendants, seeking to hold them responsible for alleged economic damages stemming from the coronavirus pandemic. A federal appeals court in 2024 [USN:L1N3E12MP TEXT:"revived"] part of the lawsuit after a judge dismissed the case. The remaining claim alleges the defendants monopolized supplies of personal protective equipment (PPE), driving up prices and causing economic harm. US District Judge Stephen Limbaugh Jr entered a default judgment in March 2025 after the defendants failed to respond or make appearances in the case. The damages amount was automatically tripled under federal law after a base finding of $8 billion in compensatory damages. In August, Hubei and the Chinese Academy of Sciences in a [USN:L6N44S0TH TEXT:"court filing asked"] Limbaugh to set aside the judgment and dismiss the lawsuit. They argued the district judge has no power over them and that the default judgment improperly intrudes into foreign affairs. Missouri argues that the lawsuit doesn't impede China's sovereign authority. Hubei province and other plaintiffs are separately suing Missouri in a Chinese court, accusing the state and several officials of damaging their reputations. That lawsuit seeks public apologies in US and Chinese media, and nearly $53 billion in damages. Hubei’s case, filed in April 2025, describes Missouri's COVID-19 lawsuit as a "vexatious lawsuit about COVID-19 spread and Chinese state acts." The case is Missouri v. People’s Republic of China et al, US District Court for the Eastern District of Missouri, No. 1:20-cv-00099-SNLJ. For Missouri: Louis Capozzi III and J. item.title: Importaciones soja UE en temporada 2026/27 caen 3% al 18 de octubre
item.description: Las importaciones de soja de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, sumaban 3,6 millones de toneladas métricas al 18 de octubre, lo que supone un descenso del 3% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior, según los datos publicados el martes por la Comisión Europea.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las importaciones de soja de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, sumaban 3,6 millones de toneladas métricas al 18 de octubre, lo que supone un descenso del 3% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior, según los datos publicados el martes por la Comisión Europea. Las importaciones de colza de la UE en el mismo periodo sumaban 1,1 millones de toneladas, lo que supone un descenso del 10% respecto al año anterior. Por su parte, las importaciones de harina de soja cayeron un 16%, hasta los 5,3 millones de toneladas. Las importaciones de aceite de palma de la UE se situaron en 0,8 millones de toneladas, un 22 % menos que el año anterior.

item.title: Titans cut DL Jordan Elliott after 'incident' at team facility
item.description: The Tennessee Titans released defensive lineman Jordan Elliott on Tuesday following "an incident" at the team facility last week.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Tennessee Titans released defensive lineman Jordan Elliott on Tuesday following "an incident" at the team facility last week. "On Thursday, October 15, there was an incident at our team facility involving Jordan Elliott," the team said in a statement. "Following our review of the incident, we have made the decision to release Elliott from our roster. We will have no further comment on the matter." Elliott, 28, did not play in the 26-20 victory at Indianapolis on Sunday that gave the Titans (1-5) their first win of the season. He was listed on last Friday's practice report as not practicing for personal reasons. He appeared in the first five games (one start) and contributed 11 tackles across 138 total snaps (24 on special teams). A third-round draft pick by Cleveland in 2020, Elliott has collected 159 tackles, 14 quarterback hits and five sacks in 102 career games (65 starts) with the Browns (2020-23), San Francisco 49ers (2024-25) and Titans. --Field Level Media

item.title: European stocks extend slide as French protests dent risk appetite
item.description: European shares fell on Tuesday as violent protests in France, the region's second-biggest economy, continued to dampen risk appetite across the euro zone.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P
item.content:encoded: European shares fell on Tuesday as violent protests in France, the region's second-biggest economy, continued to dampen risk appetite across the euro zone. The protests, which began over the weekend, have intensified pressure on a country already grappling with soft economic growth and ballooning government debt, while presidential elections are due in six months. Late on Monday, French [USN:L6N4650BY TEXT:"authorities set curfews"] in parts of several cities including Paris, Lille and Nice. The pan-European STOXX 600 index (.STOXX) was down 0.51% at 636.32 points by 0837 GMT on Tuesday, after slipping 0.8% in the previous session. France's benchmark CAC 40 index (.FCHI) edged 0.41% lower. France's government bond yields edged lower on Tuesday after their biggest daily rise in nearly a month as investors remained cautious ahead of a vote on the budget bill later in the day. "It's tough for investors to get particularly emboldened by Europe now," said Neil Wilson, investor strategist at Saxo UK. "How much exposure do you want to Europe right now when you're not really sure what sort of policies are going to be pursued by government over the next few years, and France being the focal point for that." Most of the major European sectors were trading lower, with technology (.SX8P) and industrials (.SXNP) leading declines. Investors also assessed a raft of corporate earnings reports. French cloud operator OVHcloud (OVH.PA) jumped 7.9% after reporting its [USN:L6N4660C3 TEXT:"first positive levered free cash flow"] since its 2021 listing, as its revenue expanded 7.2% to €1.15 billion ($1.29 billion) in the financial year through August. Comet Holding (COTNE.S) jumped 4.1% after the electronic equipment maker reported a third-quarter sales increase, citing expansion of data centres and AI infrastructure. ABB (ABBN.S) fell 5.3% despite the Swiss engineering company reporting record quarterly orders. Schneider Electric (SCHN.PA) fell 2.1% after the French electrical equipment maker raised €6 billion ($6.74 billion) in an accelerated bookbuild, a fast share sale to institutional investors. Markets will also parse comments from European Central Bank policymaker Olli Rehn, scheduled to speak later on Tuesday, for clues on the bank's policy path. Traders currently expect interest rates to remain on hold at the ECB's October meeting, while pricing in an 87% chance of a hike in December, according to LSEG-compiled data.

item.title: Wolves F Jaden McDaniels agrees to $40M extension
item.description: Minnesota Timberwolves forward Jaden McDaniels agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension through the 2029-30 season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Minnesota Timberwolves forward Jaden McDaniels agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension through the 2029-30 season. His representatives from Innovate Sports and WME Basketball confirmed the deal's details with ESPN on Monday night. Under the terms, McDaniels will be able to negotiate another extension as early as 2028 or enter free agency in the summer of 2030. McDaniels, who turned 26 last month, signed a five-year, $136 million contract with the Timberwolves in October 2023. He averaged a career-high 14.8 points with 4.2 rebounds and 2.7 assists and shot 41.2% from 3-point range in 73 games (all starts) in 2025-26. The 2020 first-round draft pick will tip off his seventh campaign with Minnesota in Wednesday night's season opener at Miami. --Field Level Media

item.title: US judge rejects Trump administration bid to block NAACP lawsuit against Musk's xAI over data center
item.description: A federal judge in Mississippi has rejected a bid by President Donald Trump’s administration to dismiss a lawsuit by civil rights groups alleging Elon Musk's xAI violated environmental laws to power an AI data center.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: A federal judge in Mississippi has rejected a bid by President Donald Trump’s administration to dismiss a lawsuit by civil rights groups alleging Elon Musk's xAI violated environmental laws to power an AI data center. US District Judge Debra Brown on Monday said the US Environmental Protection Agency could intervene in the case but lacked authority under the Clean Air Act to unilaterally terminate the lawsuit after joining it. The lawsuit, [USN:L1N40X13Z TEXT:"filed"] in April by the National Association for the Advancement of Colored People and the Mississippi State Conference of the NAACP, alleges that xAI and a subsidiary violated federal law and state regulations by constructing and operating a gas-fired power plant in Southaven, Mississippi, without required permits. The EPA, xAI and NAACP did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The Trump administration in June [USN:L6N42O0B5 TEXT:"sought to intervene"] on behalf of the EPA and argued that the agency could dismiss the case because federal regulators have authority over Clean Air Act enforcement. Brown ruled that although the EPA has a right to intervene in such private enforcement suits, there’s nothing in the statute allowing the agency to dismiss a case unless it is pursuing a related action. "The EPA’s role as a primary enforcer of the Clean Air Act does not mean that the federal government retains complete control over all Clean Air Act litigation," Brown wrote. Data centers fueling the rise of AI have become a [USN:L6N43G12P TEXT:"political flashpoint"] in communities across the country, with [USN:L1N43F0PK TEXT:"opposition"] uniting voters across ideological lines. Musk’s xAI also faces [USN:L6N42H16S TEXT:"other lawsuits"] over data centers and power consumption. In one case, a group of Mississippi residents in June alleged that a power plant fueling data centers is blasting “omnipresent and inescapable” noise that has eroded their health and home values. The case is NAACP et al v. X.AI et al, US District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi, No. 3:26-cv-00074-DMB. item.title: Importaciones maíz UE se disparan 40% tras sequía, exportaciones trigo blando se mantienen estables
item.description: Las importaciones de maíz de la Unión Europea en la campaña 2026/27 se dispararon un 40% interanual al 18 de octubre, impulsadas por un aumento de más del triple en los envíos procedentes de Estados Unidos, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las importaciones de maíz de la Unión Europea en la campaña 2026/27 se dispararon un 40% interanual al 18 de octubre, impulsadas por un aumento de más del triple en los envíos procedentes de Estados Unidos, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes. En tanto, las exportaciones de trigo blando se mantuvieron estables. Los analistas y los grupos de presión del sector habían pronosticado que las importaciones se dispararían esta temporada, ya que empresas como los fabricantes de piensos y tratan de compensar la cosecha de la UE, devastada por la sequía, que se prevé que sea la más baja al menos desde el año 2000. Las importaciones de maíz de la UE desde principios de julio sumaban 6,64 millones de toneladas métricas hasta el domingo, de las cuales 2,9 millones proceden de EEUU. A la misma fecha del año anterior, la UE solo había importado unas 900.000 toneladas de maíz estadounidense. Ucrania también parece haberse beneficiado del aumento de la demanda de importación de maíz de la UE, ya que los envíos procedentes de este país se han más que duplicado en términos interanuales, pasando de 770.000 a 1,62 millones de toneladas. Brasil, por el contrario, perdió terreno a pesar de seguir siendo el segundo mayor proveedor de maíz de la UE, con unas importaciones que cayeron a 1,82 millones de toneladas desde los 2,74 millones de toneladas del año anterior. En cuanto al trigo blando, las exportaciones de la UE en la campaña 2026/27 se mantuvieron estables respecto al año anterior al 18 de octubre, situándose en 8,47 millones de toneladas. Rumania fue el mayor exportador de trigo blando de la UE con 3,68 millones de toneladas, seguida de Lituania con 1,29 millones de toneladas, Polonia con 0,97 millones de toneladas, Letonia con 0,89 millones de toneladas, y Bulgaria con 0,73 millones de toneladas. Los datos de exportación de Francia han sido incompletos desde principios de 2024, los de Bulgaria e Irlanda lo han sido desde el inicio de la campaña de comercialización 2023/24, y los de Grecia lo han sido desde enero de 2026. Las exportaciones de cebada de la UE alcanzaron los 2,22 millones de toneladas, lo que supone un aumento respecto a los 2,10 millones de toneladas de la semana anterior, pero un descenso del 41% en términos interanuales.

item.title: Monedas suben en medio de descenso del dólar a nivel global; Brasil espera balotaje
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina subían el martes, respaldadas por el descenso del dólar a nivel global, con los mercados de Brasil avanzando en medio de posicionamientos previos al balotaje presidencial del domingo.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina subían el martes, respaldadas por el descenso del dólar a nivel global, con los mercados de Brasil avanzando en medio de posicionamientos previos al balotaje presidencial del domingo. * El dólar descendía al resurgir las dudas sobre el comercio relacionado con la inteligencia artificial, mientras que el euro ascendía ligeramente pese a las persistentes preocupaciones de los operadores por los disturbios en Francia. * El ánimo de los inversores era apuntalado además por una fuerte caída de los precios del petróleo, que reducían los temores sobre la inflación, y también un retroceso de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos. * El real brasileño subía un 0,4% a 5,0119 por dólar, con el mercado atento al balotaje presidencial. Mientras, el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) escalaba un 1,47% a 208.087 puntos, con datos mostrando flujos de inversores extranjeros hacia las acciones locales antes de la segunda vuelta de la elección del fin de semana. * Los sondeos muestran una estrecha carrera entre el senador de derecha Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente de izquierda Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, aunque la mayoría de las pesquisas dan una leve ventaja para Bolsonaro, quien ganó la primera vuelta pese a que las encuestas daban ventaja al mandatario. * El peso mexicano ganaba un mínimo un 0,04%, a 18,4109 unidades por dólar, después de cotizar en rojo más temprano. * A nivel local, los inversionistas asimilaban cifras preliminares que mostraron que la [USN:S0N45D031 TEXT:"actividad económica"] se expandió un 3,7% en septiembre a tasa interanual. * En tanto, el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, trepaba un 1,02%, a 69.712,35 puntos, en su cuarta sesión seguida de avances y en medio de los primeros resultados corporativos del tercer trimestre. * El peso chileno , subía un 0,62%, a 974,80/975,10 unidades por dólar. Asimismo, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , sumaba un 0,30%, a 11.005,53 puntos. * El peso colombiano se fortalecía un leve 0,09% a 3.155 unidades por dólar; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) retrocedía un 0,09% a 2.519,07 puntos. * El peso interbancario argentino cedía apenas un 0,07% a 1.525,5 por dólar con intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA), que supera compras por 15.500 millones de dólares en el transcurso del año. * La Secretaría de Finanzas argentina llevará a cabo el martes una conversión de títulos para ofrecer a modo de canje anticipado y reducir la potencial volatilidad cambiaria antes de la fijación del precio el 27 de octubre. * El índice accionario MSCI Merval (.MMXMRVLGA) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires, en tanto, ganaba un 1,4% revirtiendo fuertes pérdidas de más temprano. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreciaba un 0,23% a 3,4280/3,4290 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) avanzaba un 0,48% a 1.586,14 puntos.

item.title: Legisladores de la UE llegan a un acuerdo para rebajar objetivos de emisiones de CO₂ de los coches
item.description: Los legisladores de la Unión Europea acordaron suavizar los objetivos propuestos para las emisiones de coches de la UE en 2035, permitiendo a los fabricantes de automóviles compensar parte del déficit previsto mediante el uso de acero de la UE con bajas emisiones de carbono, según el texto del acuerdo al que ha tenido acceso Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Philip Blenkinsop
item.content:encoded: Los legisladores de la Unión Europea acordaron suavizar los objetivos propuestos para las emisiones de coches de la UE en 2035, permitiendo a los fabricantes de automóviles compensar parte del déficit previsto mediante el uso de acero de la UE con bajas emisiones de carbono, según el texto del acuerdo al que ha tenido acceso Reuters. La Comisión Europea propuso el año pasado que los fabricantes de automóviles redujeran las emisiones de CO₂ en un 90% en 2035 con respecto a los niveles de 2021, lo que supone un descenso respecto al objetivo anterior del 100%. El ejecutivo de la UE afirmó que el 10% restante podría compensarse mediante el uso de acero con bajas emisiones de carbono y combustibles alternativos. El acuerdo alcanzado entre los tres principales grupos políticos del Parlamento Europeo establece, en cambio, un objetivo de reducción del 87,5% para los turismos, con un complemento del 7,5% procedente de la producción que utilice acero con bajas emisiones de carbono fabricado en la Unión Europea. El acuerdo aún debe ser ratificado por los grupos —el Partido Popular Europeo (de centro-derecha), los socialdemócratas (de centro-izquierda) y Renew (más centrista)— para establecer la posición del Parlamento Europeo. LA AMBICIÓN CLIMÁTICA DE LA UE SE HA DEBILITADO A continuación, el Parlamento y los gobiernos de la UE tendrían que ponerse de acuerdo sobre un texto común relativo a los objetivos de emisiones para las flotas de turismos nuevos para 2030 y 2035. Los países de la UE llevan mucho tiempo defendiendo los esfuerzos para reducir las emisiones de carbono con el fin de frenar el calentamiento global, pero las consideraciones económicas han llevado en los últimos años a una reducción de la ambición. Francia y Alemania, que cuentan con importantes industrias automotrices, acordaron la semana pasada reducir los objetivos de emisiones de CO₂ para los turismos en 2035 al 90%, sin necesidad de medidas compensatorias. Según el texto del acuerdo alcanzado a primera hora del martes, los grupos parlamentarios acordaron que los fabricantes de automóviles deberían reducir las emisiones promedio de las furgonetas nuevas en un 80% en 2035. Para 2030, los objetivos de reducción de CO₂ propuestos serían del 55% para los turismos, tal y como propuso la Comisión el año pasado, y del 35% para las furgonetas, por debajo del 40% propuesto por la Comisión. Los fabricantes de automóviles podrían cumplir los objetivos de 2030 mediante la media de los años 2029 a 2031. Los turismos que funcionen con combustibles renovables también podrían reconocerse como vehículos de cero emisiones. Los turismos eléctricos pequeños y asequibles, así como los vehículos eléctricos especialmente eficientes, podrían reportar a los fabricantes "supercréditos", lo que les ayudaría a cumplir los objetivos de emisiones.

item.title: Príncipe Harry diz que quer se reconciliar com a família
item.description: O príncipe Harry afirmou que espera se reconciliar com o rei Charles e o restante de sua família, de quem se afastou quando se mudou para os Estados Unidos há seis anos.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: O príncipe Harry afirmou que espera se reconciliar com o rei Charles e o restante de sua família, de quem se afastou quando se mudou para os Estados Unidos há seis anos. Harry, de 42 anos, o filho mais novo do rei, causou uma grande ruptura na família real britânica quando ele e sua esposa, Meghan, abandonaram as funções reais e se mudaram para a Califórnia em 2020, de onde passaram a criticar duramente a instituição. Ele mal fala com seu irmão mais velho, o herdeiro príncipe William, há anos, e sua família só recentemente se reuniu novamente com seu pai. Em entrevista à revista GQ, Harry, que recentemente se mudou de volta para o Reino Unido com Meghan e seus dois filhos, disse que gostaria de fazer as pazes. “Com tudo o que está acontecendo no mundo, o mais importante é a reconciliação”, declarou ele à GQ. O príncipe disse que consegue entender o fascínio pela situação de sua família, já que as pessoas se identificam com ela. “Existem desentendimentos entre irmãos, há relacionamentos rompidos entre filhos e seus pais, entre filhos e um dos pais”, afirmou. Algumas pessoas podem se inspirar nos esforços de reconciliação, e isso pode ajudar em seus próprios relacionamentos. “E algumas pessoas não querem que isso dê certo. Eu quero que dê certo”, acrescentou. O porta-voz de Harry disse que esses últimos comentários não foram feitos com a intenção de criticar William ou qualquer outro membro da família. Harry, o duque de Sussex, continuou dizendo à GQ que, embora “as cicatrizes permaneçam para sempre”, ele quer encorajar todos a deixarem o passado para trás. “Para mim, já há drama suficiente no mundo e na vida das pessoas para continuarmos com problemas familiares”, afirmou ele. “Não vale a pena.” FILHOS ESTÃO “ADORANDO” ESCOLA NO REINO UNIDO Na longa entrevista, Harry também abordou temas sobre os quais já havia falado anteriormente, como o impacto da perda de sua mãe, a princesa Diana, quando ele tinha 12 anos, e suas dificuldades com a saúde mental. Mas ele também falou sobre o motivo de ter voltado ao Reino Unido, dizendo que poder matricular seus filhos em uma escola britânica “significou muito para mim”. “Eu não sabia o quanto isso era importante para mim. Sempre achei que seria algo que tentaríamos fazer, mas agora eles já estão na escola há duas semanas. Estão adorando e isso está proporcionando a eles uma experiência totalmente diferente.” Ele também disse que espera que sua relação tensa com a imprensa britânica — que, em parte, levou à sua saída e resultou em uma série de processos judiciais contra grupos de jornais — agora melhore. “Minha esperança é que isso mude”, declarou. “Houve algumas batalhas que tiveram de ser travadas, por necessidade. Mas espero que todos possamos deixar isso para trás."

item.content:encoded: Bundeskanzler Friedrich Merz hat den Beitrag türkischer Zuwanderer zu Deutschlands Entwicklung gewürdigt und vor neuem Fremdenhass gewarnt. "Türkische Gastarbeiterinnen und Gastarbeiter haben die industrielle Substanz unseres Landes mit aufgebaut", sagte der CDU-Vorsitzende am Dienstag in Berlin zum 65. Jubiläum des deutsch-türkischen Anwerbeabkommens. Das Ruhrgebiet wäre ohne die Arbeit und den "oft außergewöhnlichen Fleiß" der türkischen Arbeitskräfte nicht so wohlhabend und großartig geworden. "Sie haben die Substanz aufgebaut in unserem Land, die Infrastruktur des Wohlstandes geschaffen, in der wir heute leben." Zugleich kritisierte der Kanzler, dass die Zuwanderer teilweise und trotz vieler Anstrengungen immer noch wie Fremde behandelt würden. "Integration ist eine Aufgabe jeder modernen, pluralistischen Gesellschaft", mahnte Merz in diesem Zusammenhang. Der CDU-Vorsitzende distanzierte sich ausdrücklich von dem AfD-Ansatz einer "Remigration", die auch Deutsche mit Migrationshintergrund mit einer Abschiebung bedroht. Dieses "Unwort" sei ein "Angriff auf das moderne Deutschland, das wir uns in den vergangenen 65 Jahren miteinander aufgebaut haben". Die Angst vor dem Fremden sei weiterhin ideologisch infektiös und werde gerade wieder politisch aufgeladen. Zugleich betonte der Kanzler, dass die Bundesregierung die Migration ordnen und begrenzen wolle, "damit wir als Gesellschaft genügend Ressourcen haben für die Integration in unsere Kitas, in unsere Schulen, in unsere Ausbildung". Man müsse darauf achten, dass eine offene und tolerante Gesellschaft nicht überfordert werde und in Richtung Ausgrenzung und Intoleranz kippe. Merz bekannte sich aber zu einer verstärkten Zuwanderung von ausländischen Arbeitskräften und würdigte auch die kulturellen Beiträge etwa der türkischen Einwanderer. Die Regierung arbeite an einer sogenannten Work-and-Stay-Agentur, um die Fachkräfteeinwanderung zu erleichtern. Das deutsch-türkische Anwerbeabkommen von 1961 sei eine Erfolgsgeschichte, betonte Merz. Das Abkommen war geschlossen worden, um die boomende deutsche Wirtschaft zu dieser Zeit mit Arbeitskräften zu versorgen. Ursprünglich war eine Aufenthaltsdauer von zwei Jahren vorgesehen gewesen, aber rund die Hälfte der Angeworbenen arbeitete auch danach in Deutschland weiter und blieb.

item.title: Bayern's Kompany, Kimmich, Neuer doubtful for Arsenal clash, says assistant coach
item.description: Bayern Munich could be without coach Vincent Kompany, first-choice goalkeeper Manuel Neuer and playmaker Joshua Kimmich when they host Arsenal in the Champions League on Wednesday, assistant coach Aaron Danks said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bayern Munich could be without coach Vincent Kompany, first-choice goalkeeper Manuel Neuer and playmaker Joshua Kimmich when they host Arsenal in the Champions League on Wednesday, assistant coach Aaron Danks said on Tuesday. Kompany is nursing a virus that has affected his legs at times, while Neuer has only just recovered from a minor injury and Kimmich missed training due to personal reasons, Danks told a press conference. "Vince has had a virus, and it is important for him to rest," Danks said. "So he is at home. We are taking it day by day. He will play his role in the game whether in the Allianz Arena or not." As for Neuer, no decision has yet been made, Danks said, with the keeper back in training for the past two days. Kimmich's participation is equally unclear. "For Joshua it is personal reasons. I am not sure what it means for tomorrow," Danks added. Bayern, already without suspended Michael Olise, want to bounce back in the competition after last week's 3-3 [USN:L6N45Z15P TEXT:"draw"] against Viking in Norway, and have been boosted by a 6-1 [USN:L6N46305Y TEXT:"demolition"] of RB Leipzig in the Bundesliga on Saturday. "The key will be decided on small margins," Danks said. "We have to be prepared for every aspect of the game. "We trust the process and the work we have done with the players in the last couple of seasons. We want them to play fearless and express themselves."

item.title: US energy department official says working with refiners on producing more diesel
item.description: Diesel prices are higher than anyone wants right now and the US is working with refiners to seek ways to produce more, US Energy Department official Kyle Haustveit told a conference on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Diesel prices are higher than anyone wants right now and the US is working with refiners to seek ways to produce more, US Energy Department official Kyle Haustveit told a conference on Tuesday. "We are working with our friends... to find new and innovative ways to get more throughput" of the fuel through refineries, said Energy Department Under Secretary Haustveit at the Drake Forum in Titusville, Pennsylvania. He said the Trump administration was also working with "friends and allies" on releasing diesel and worked with Europe to release another 50 million barrels of the fuel, which has shot higher on disruptions from the wars in Iran and Ukraine. While the Trump administration has pushed for that 50 million barrel level, an actual agreement by industrialized nations fell short. The Paris-based International Energy Agency announced last week that it would speed the release of crude and oil product volumes pledged in March, including more than 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible. Fatih Birol, the chief of the IEA which coordinates industrialized nations' releases of oil from emergency stocks, said on Tuesday the [USN:L6N4660MV TEXT:"group is ready"] to coordinate more oil releases by member countries if needed.

item.title: Starboard's Smith unveils stake in Solstice, presses for improvements
item.description: Activist investor Starboard Value on Tuesday unveiled a new stake in Honeywell spin-off Solstice Advanced Materials , arguing the company is undervalued and needs someone to hold management accountable for boosting share price performance.
item.dc:creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
item.content:encoded: Activist investor Starboard Value on Tuesday unveiled a new stake in Honeywell spin-off Solstice Advanced Materials (SOLS.O) , arguing the company is undervalued and needs someone to hold management accountable for boosting share price performance. Solstice is trading "stupid cheap," Starboard managing member and chief executive Jeffrey Smith said at the annual 13D Monitor Active-Passive Investor Summit in New York. Solstice has "great businesses but is undervalued," Smith said, attributing the discount to the market losing faith in management's ability to get the best out of its core business lines. To improve performance, management should focus on its core refrigerants and nuclear businesses and cut roughly $100 million in costs across the company, Smith said. Solstice did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Spun out of Honeywell (HON.O) a year ago, Solstice initially saw its share price gain significantly. However, it is down roughly 30% since closing at an all-time high on June 30, in part having failed to recover from an aborted $14.5 billion deal to buy specialty chemicals company Element Solutions (ESI.N) . The [USN:L4N4380RV TEXT:"cash-and-stock deal"] was announced on July 6, and was billed as a way for Solstice to capitalize on growing demand from data centers and the chip industries. However, following feedback from shareholders on both sides, the companies [USN:L4N44O21D TEXT:"canceled the agreement"] on August 27. Smith also discussed the firm's investment in Knife River Corp (KNF.N) , where Reuters [USN:L1N4650SX TEXT:"reported"] on Monday that Starboard has lined up director candidates for election to the company's board. On Tuesday, Smith said that the company is "a very attractive acquisition target." Since making its investment public in September, Starboard has pushed Knife River to boost its profit margins. The company did not respond to a request for comment from Reuters.

item.title: US Energy Department to invest nearly $1 billion for new power grid upgrades
item.description: The US Department of Energy on Tuesday said it would invest roughly $967 million in additional funding to modernize critical energy infrastructure in a bid to lower surging electricity costs.
item.dc:creator: Arathy Somasekhar
item.content:encoded: The US Department of Energy on Tuesday said it would invest roughly $967 million in additional funding to modernize critical energy infrastructure in a bid to lower surging electricity costs. The funding is through the Grid Resilience State and Tribal Formula Grant program and will support projects to help states, territories and tribes invest in infrastructure improvements to ensure more affordable and dependable power, the DOE said.

item.dc:creator: Ju-min Park, Christina Amann
item.content:encoded: Europas größter Autobauer Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) setzt im Kampf gegen seine Absatzkrise viel Hoffnung in die Kooperation mit dem chinesischen Startup Xpeng (9868.HK) . Von der 2023 besiegelten Zusammenarbeit versprachen sich die VW-Manager eine Abkürzung auf dem schwierigen Weg zu wettbewerbsfähigen Elektroautos in China - und eine Blaupause dafür, die vom Westen bewunderte "China-Speed" in Wolfsburg einziehen zu lassen. Drei Jahre später ist mit dem ID.UNYX 08 zwar das erste gemeinsame Auto auf dem Markt - aber es verkauft sich schlechter als geplant. Das zeigt, wie schwierig es für den einstigen Branchenprimus ist, auf dem extrem umkämpften chinesischen Markt wieder Tritt zu fassen. Der Wolfsburger Autobauer war lange Zeit Platzhirsch in China: Noch 2019 war jeder fünfte verkaufte Neuwagen ein VW. Inzwischen ist der Marktanteil auf zehn Prozent in diesem Jahr zusammengeschrumpft. Das hat auch Folgen für die Konzernbilanz: In der Vergangenheit sorgte China für etwa die Hälfte des Gewinns bei Volkswagen, nun sind es gerade einmal rund zehn Prozent. Deshalb herrscht in den Führungsetagen in der Zentrale in Wolfsburg Alarmstufe Rot, das Management um Vorstandschef Oliver Blume verfolgt einen harten Spar- und Schrumpfkurs. SCHWACHE VERKAUFSZAHLEN Seit Verkaufsstart im April wurden nach Daten des Beratungsunternehmens ThinkerCar im Schnitt monatlich gerade einmal 267 Stück vom einstigen Hoffnungsträger UNYX 08 verkauft. Das ist ein Bruchteil der 3622 Fahrzeuge pro Monat, die sich VW nach Reuters vorliegenden Unterlagen für 2026 vorgenommen hat. Der Neustart kommt zu einem ungünstigen Zeitpunkt: Der chinesische Markt bricht ein. Verbrennerautos sind wegen der mit dem Irankrieg gestiegenen Spritpreise weniger gefragt. Die zuvor stark gestiegene Elektroauto-Nachfrage leidet unter dem Wegfall staatlicher Kaufanreize. Insgesamt herrscht in China auch wegen der Nachwehen der Immobilienkrise, einer hohen Arbeitslosigkeit vor allem bei jungen Menschen und der unklaren wirtschaftlichen Aussichten Kaufzurückhaltung. Der Konkurrenzkampf von mehr als 100 Herstellern wird unterdessen immer schärfer. Chris Liu, Experte beim Analysehaus Omdia, weist darauf hin, dass derzeit auf dem weltweit größten Automarkt im Schnitt täglich drei neue Modelle vorgestellt würden. "Es ist das schlechtestmögliche Jahr, ein neues Modell in China auf den Markt zu bringen", sagte Liu. Der UNYX 08 hat es gegen die Konkurrenz schwer: Der Xiaomi YU7 bietet zum gleichen Preis von rund 34.500 Dollar mehr Sensoren, der Zeekr 7X lädt deutlich schneller. Nach Daten von ThinkerCar wurden zwischen April und August fast 57.000 YU7 und mehr als 21.000 7X verkauft, verglichen mit den 1300 UNYX 08. "Chinesische Kunden fragen sich, warum sie ein teures deutsches Auto kaufen sollen, wenn sie die Technologie viel billiger haben können", sagte Pedro Pacheco, Experte beim Analysehaus Gartner. Dabei hat VW schon früh erkannt, dass die Tage der Benzin- und Dieselautos gezählt sind. Vor sieben Jahren kündigten die Wolfsburger an, bis 2025 in China 40 neue Elektroautos und Hybride auf den Markt zu bringen. Absatzziel waren 1,5 Millionen Pkw. Im vergangenen Jahr waren es nur 115.500. Aber auch BMW (BMWG.DE) und Mercedes-Benz (MBGn.DE) haben es auf dem chinesischen E-Auto-Markt schwer. Stefan Bratzel, Chef des Center of Automotive Management, führt das auf Managementfehler zurück. Die deutschen Automanager hätten unterschätzt, wie schnell die chinesischen Hersteller das Ruder übernehmen, auch dank der staatlichen Förderung. MANKO IM VERTRIEB? Ralf Brandstätter, der seit 2022 das China-Geschäft bei VW leitet, setzt auf Kooperationen, um wieder Boden gutzumachen. Insidern zufolge erwog VW 2022 eine Zusammenarbeit mit BYD und 2023 mit Leapmotor, beides zerschlug sich. Dann wurde 2023 die Kooperation mit Xpeng unterzeichnet, die eine neue Architektur für Elektroautos und schnellere Entwicklung zum Ziel hatte. Technisch sei die Zusammenarbeit ein Erfolg, sagte einer der Insider. Volkswagen erklärte dazu, die gemeinsame Architektur CEA sei in einer Rekordzeit von 18 Monaten entwickelt worden. Eine Ursache der Absatzschwäche ist den Insidern zufolge das lückenhafte Vertriebsnetz. Das Auto sei deshalb zu wenig bekannt. Der UNYX 08 wird vor allem über ein neues Händlernetz von Volkswagen Anhui verkauft, und nicht über die mehr als 3000 Händler, die VW mit seinen Partnern FAW und SAIC bedient. Laut Volkswagen hat das Anhui-Händlernetz 166 Niederlassungen. Mit FAW soll das Auto künftig über mehr Anlaufstellen angeboten werden. Der Absatz der UNYX-Modelle ziehe an, erklärte VW. Vor zwei Jahren peilte Volkswagen 32.600 verkaufte UNYX 08 für 2026 und 70.400 für 2027 an, wie aus den Unterlagen hervorgeht. Vor einigen Monaten wurden diese Prognosen auf 12.300 und 64.000 gekürzt. Als zweites mit Xpeng entwickeltes Auto kommt demnächst der UNYX 09 heraus. Das Absatzziel ist mit 4900 Stück pro Monat oder fast 60.000 im Jahr wieder hoch gesteckt. Ambitionierte Ziele seien notwendig, damit die Zentrale in Wolfsburg grünes Licht für ein Fahrzeugprojekt gibt, sagten zwei Insider. VW-China-Chef Brandstätter informierte die Belegschaft im September über die schwierige Lage. Die Branche kämpfe mit einer "außergewöhnlichen" Kontraktion, hieß es in der Reuters vorliegenden Botschaft. VW erwarte, dass der chinesische Automarkt 2026 um 20 Prozent oder rund 4,5 Millionen Fahrzeuge schrumpft. Die Gewinnmargen in der Branche seien auf 1,5 Prozent gesunken. Die Produktzyklen hätten sich auf drei von sieben Jahren verkürzt, neue Modelle verkauften sich schon nach drei Monaten kaum noch. Volkswagen müsse deswegen seine Produktionskapazitäten an die Marktrealität anpassen. Ein ehemaliger VW-Mitarbeiter verglich die Entwicklung mit dem, was Nokia, Kodak oder BlackBerry passierte - die Marken gingen unter, weil sie Innovationen versäumten. Bill Russo, Gründer des Beratungsunternehmens Automobility in Shanghai, sieht noch Erholungschancen für Volkswagen in China, gibt aber zu bedenken: "Das Risiko ist, dass sich der Markt schneller bewegt, als sich das Unternehmen neu erfinden kann."

item.title: 0ver 120 international players on NBA opening-night rosters
item.description: Opening-night rosters will feature 125 international players, the NBA said on Tuesday, with France becoming the first country outside Canada in 13 seasons to lead the league in international representatives.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Opening-night rosters will feature 125 international players, the NBA said on Tuesday, with France becoming the first country outside Canada in 13 seasons to lead the league in international representatives. The 2026-27 season tips off on Tuesday, marking the 13th consecutive year where at least 100 international players are on opening-night rosters, with 43 countries represented across six continents. France is the most-represented outside the US with 17 players, a group headlined by San Antonio Spurs' twice All-Star and reigning Defensive Player of the Year Victor Wembanyama. Canada, which for the past 12 seasons had led the league in international players, is next with 16 players, followed by Australia (9), Germany (7), Nigeria (6) and Serbia (6). The Dallas Mavericks, Miami Heat and Washington Wizards feature a league-high seven international players each. The NBA said there were 70 European players on opening-night rosters, including the Heat's Giannis Antetokounmpo (Greece), Denver Nuggets' Nikola Jokic (Serbia) and Los Angeles Lakers' Luka Doncic (Slovenia). The league is staging three games outside of the US and Canada this season as part of its efforts to grow the game globally. Denver and Indiana will meet in Mexico City on November 7 before January games between New Orleans and San Antonio in Paris and Manchester.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo decepcionou o Manchester United, diz ex-técnico Ten Hag
item.description: O ex-técnico do Manchester United Erik ten Hag atribuiu as dificuldades enfrentadas por Cristiano Ronaldo durante sua segunda passagem pelo clube à falta de condicionamento físico e preparação do atacante, afirmando que o jogador da seleção de Portugal “decepcionou a equipe”.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O ex-técnico do Manchester United Erik ten Hag atribuiu as dificuldades enfrentadas por Cristiano Ronaldo durante sua segunda passagem pelo clube à falta de condicionamento físico e preparação do atacante, afirmando que o jogador da seleção de Portugal “decepcionou a equipe”. Ronaldo conquistou três títulos da Premier League sob o comando de Alex Ferguson antes de deixar o United para se transferir ao Real Madrid em 2009, retornando a Old Trafford em 2021. Mas, sob o comando do holandês Ten Hag, Ronaldo enfrentou dificuldades na temporada 2022-23, marcando apenas um gol em 10 partidas pelo campeonato antes de deixar o clube em novembro de 2022. “Ele decepcionou a equipe e me decepcionou, porque tínhamos planos com ele”, disse Ten Hag ao The Athletic em uma entrevista publicada na terça-feira. A Reuters entrou em contato com os representantes de Ronaldo para obter um comentário. Ten Hag, que levou o United ao terceiro lugar no campeonato de 2022-23, disse ter confrontado Ronaldo sobre o desempenho do jogador. “Muitas vezes eu dizia: ‘Ronnie, todo mundo quer trabalhar para te colocar na posição certa, mas se você não consegue chegar à área, não consegue marcar’. Ele não era capaz de fazer isso”, disse Ten Hag, que foi demitido pelo United em 2024. “É um equívoco atribuir a mim a ideia de que eu esperava que ele fizesse a pressão, alegando que ele está exausto. Mas ele não conseguia. Ele não corria nem com a posse de bola nem sem ela. O motivo era que ele não se preparava.” Ronaldo se transferiu para o clube saudita Al-Nassr em dezembro de 2022 e marcou 14 gols no campeonato em 16 partidas antes do fim da temporada. “Obviamente, ele é um dos melhores da história do futebol. Eu o respeitava muito. Mas, naquele momento, como técnico, tive que tomar uma decisão racional e manter em campo os jogadores que admiro”, disse Ten Hag. Ronaldo, maior artilheiro de todos os tempos de Portugal com 146 gols, recebeu uma suspensão de 30 dias da federação de futebol do país na segunda-feira, depois de ter deixado o centro de treinamento da seleção após um desentendimento com o técnico Jorge Jesus.

item.title: EU unveils new Arctic strategy with focus on security
item.description: The European Union on Tuesday presented a new Arctic strategy reflecting the region’s importance to security, with pledges to boost satellite surveillance, increase monitoring of undersea cables and help EU members buy icebreakers.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Union on Tuesday presented a new Arctic strategy reflecting [USN:L6N40D0ZD TEXT:"the region’s importance to security"], with pledges to boost satellite surveillance, increase monitoring of undersea cables and help EU members buy icebreakers. The Arctic is of growing interest to major powers including the US, Russia, China and Europe, as melting ice opens up new shipping routes. US President Donald Trump tried to acquire [USN:L6N460097 TEXT:"Greenland"], a territory of EU member Denmark, while friction has grown between Arctic nations and Russia since Moscow's 2022 invasion of Ukraine . "The Arctic is one place where the tectonic plates of geopolitics are colliding," said Ursula von der Leyen, the president of the European Commission, the EU's executive body. "When we see that sovereignty, territorial integrity, and the rules that have underpinned stability in the region can no longer be taken for granted, we have to act," she told reporters in Strasbourg. EU officials say Moscow has reopened and modernised Soviet-era military bases in the Arctic region in recent years and pointed out that Russia has a large concentration of nuclear weapons on the Kola Peninsula, inside the Arctic Circle. They say the Arctic has also become a testing ground for Russian missiles. Russia, for its part, has accused the NATO alliance of driving the region towards militarization. Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov said in August that Russia sought to preserve peace and stability and reduce threats to national security in the region. EU PLANS TO BOOST PROTECTION OF SUBSEA CABLES Reflecting increased concerns about the safety of vital undersea cables and pipelines, the EU strategy says it will set up a "maritime security hub" to share information between EU members and partners from various sources "from seabed to space". As a first step, the EU plans to set up an Arctic cable hub to monitor, protect and help repair cables, according to the strategy, produced by the European Commission and EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas. The EU also aims to keep a closer eye on the Arctic as part of plans to expand its Copernicus satellite observation network. The 27-country bloc - which includes Arctic nations Finland, Sweden and Denmark - also needs more icebreakers, the strategy says. The new document - which did not put a price tag on its plans - is the first update to the EU's Arctic strategy since 2021 and the latest in a series of EU steps focusing on the region. Last month, von der Leyen unveiled plans for €200 million of EU investments in Greenland .

item.title: Merz zufrieden mit Investorenkonferenz: Zusagen von 230 Mrd Euro
item.description: Bei der ersten Investorenkonferenz der Bundesregierung wurden laut Kanzler Friedrich Merz Zusagen im Umfang von rund 230 Milliarden Euro eingesammelt. "Wir sind entschlossen, Deutschland einen großen Schub zu geben", sagte der CDU-Chef am Dienstag in Berlin zu Journalisten, ohne dabei Fragen zuzulassen. Allein Amazon wolle mehr als 16 Milliarden Euro investieren. Weitere Zusagen kämen von den US-Technologiefirmen Nvidia und Microsoft, der für Lidl bekannten Schwarz-Gruppe, RWE, Sanofi und dem US-Investor Blackstone. Das Wirtschaftsministerium sprach davon, dass in diesem Jahr 228,6 Milliarden Euro in Deutschland investiert würden - davon mehr als 95 Milliarden Euro aus dem Ausland. Allerdings werden auf solchen Konferenzen oft Summen addiert, die bereits vorher entschieden worden waren.

Allein Amazon (AMZN.O) wolle mehr als [USN:L6N46516T TEXT:"16 Milliarden Euro"] investieren. Weitere Zusagen kämen von den US-Technologiefirmen Nvidia (NVDA.O) und Microsoft (MSFT.O) , der für Lidl bekannten Schwarz-Gruppe, RWE (RWEG.DE) , Sanofi (SASY.PA) und dem US-Investor Blackstone (BX.N) . Das Wirtschaftsministerium sprach davon, dass in diesem Jahr 228,6 Milliarden Euro in Deutschland investiert würden - davon mehr als 95 Milliarden Euro aus dem Ausland. Allerdings werden auf solchen Konferenzen oft Summen addiert, die bereits vorher entschieden worden waren. Merz sagte, die Regierung wolle mit Reformen dem Vertrauen gerecht werden und weitere Investorentreffen abhalten. Es sollte nur der Anfang sein. Unternehmen der Initiative "Made for Germany" hätten bis 2028 Zusagen in Höhe von 800 Milliarden Euro gemacht. "Wir sehen ein beschleunigtes Wachstum im Jahr 2026 trotz steigenden geopolitischen Drucks und eines Sprungs der Energiepreise." Die Bundesregierung rechnet - wie der Internationale Währungsfonds auch - für dieses Jahr mit einem Wachstum in Deutschland von 1,3 Prozent, nächstes Jahr dann 1,1 Prozent. Das wären erstmals seit Jahren wieder spürbare Zuwächse, die vor allem auf die schuldenfinanzierten Investitionen des Staates in die Infrastruktur und die Verteidigungsfähigkeit zurückgehen. Aber auch die Exporte waren zuletzt wieder angesprungen. "Deutschland ist zurück", sagte Finanzminister und SPD-Chef Lars Klingbeil. "Es passiert was in Deutschland." Die Regierung dürfe sich aber nicht zurücklehnen und müsse weitere Reformen angehen. Die klare Erwartung der Investoren sei gewesen, dass Deutschland dabei in Europa der Treiber sei. AMAZON INVESTIERT IN CLOUDS UND SATELLITEN Amazon teilte mit, ein knappes Drittel der 16 Milliarden Euro solle in den Ausbau von Rechenzentren fließen. Der US-Konzern sicherte sich darüber hinaus 24 Starts der europäischen Trägerrakete Ariane, um seine Telekommunikationssatelliten in die Umlaufbahn zu bringen. Das LEO-Satellitennetzwerk von Amazon soll der SpaceX (SPCX.O) -Tochter Starlink Konkurrenz machen. Dies gilt als besonders wichtig bei der Aufholjagd der deutschen und europäischen Raumfahrtindustrie und dem Versuch, sich unabhängig von dem auch politisch umstrittenen US-Milliardär Elon Musk und dessen Starlink-Netzwerk zu machen. Zuletzt waren die Starlink-Funktionen für die ukrainische Armee eingeschränkt worden. Amazon will auch seine Forschungskapazitäten für Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und Robotik in Berlin ausbauen. Weiteres Geld fließe in das Logistiknetzwerk des Online-Händlers sowie in die Produktion deutscher Shows, Filme und Serien für den Streamingdienst Amazon Prime Video, teilte das Unternehmen mit. Deutschland sei ein Innovationszentrum und einer der attraktivsten Investitionsstandorte Europas. MEHR KAPITALMARKT, WENIGER SPARBUCH Merz zufolge gab es große Unterstützung von Investoren für die Reformen im Rentensystem. Hier soll ein größerer Teil der Rente künftig aus Investments am Kapitalmarkt kommen. "Wir machen aus einem Land der Sparer ein Land der Investoren." Ähnlich äußerte sich Klingbeil. Die Frühstartrente, bei der der Staat jeden Monat zehn Euro für Kinder anlegen will, werde zu einem Kulturwandel führen. "Investitionen sind willkommen", sagte Wirtschaftsministerin Katherina Reiche (CDU). Sie sprach von imposanten Zusagen. Es gebe aber einen harten Wettbewerb um Investoren. "Die Konkurrenz schläft nicht." Enteignungen, wie sie die wahrscheinliche Landesregierung in Berlin für große Immobilienkonzerne plant, seien Gift. Die Bundesregierung werde privates Eigentum schützen. SPEED-DATING Als Stärken Deutschlands nannte Merz die politische Stabilität, die gute Bonität, die Unabhängigkeit der Gerichte, die Forschungslandschaft, die geografische Lage in der Mitte des EU-Binnenmarktes sowie die nach wie vor starke industrielle Basis. Das halbe Kabinett war bei der Konferenz anwesend und warb bei einer Schnellrunde für Investitionen in ihren Bereichen. Bauministerin Verena Hubertz (SPD) sagte, die Nachfrage nach Wohnungen sei enorm, weswegen sich allein deswegen Investitionen lohnten. Verkehrsminister Steffen Bilger (CDU) sagte, die Infrastruktur sei alt und müsse erneuert werden. Dafür habe die Regierung einen 500 Milliarden Euro schweren Sondertopf aufgelegt. Es sei ein langfristig ausgerichteter Plan, der auch Möglichkeiten für Kooperationen mit privaten Investoren schaffe. Digitalminister Karsten Wildberger (CDU) versprach Bürokratie abzubauen und die Digitalisierung der öffentlichen Verwaltung voranzutreiben.
